titulo: Your card rewards are partly paid by people using cash 💸
descripcion: Stores pay interchange fees on card sales (around 2% in the US for credit, capped at 0.3% in the EU) and build them into prices. Full breakdown in the linked video.

escenas.texto: Your credit card cash back is partly paid by people who pay with cash.
Every time you swipe, the store pays your bank a fee. In the US, it averages around two percent on credit cards.
Stores build that cost into their prices. Prices are the same whether you pay with cash or card.
In Europe, that fee is capped at zero point three percent, and the rewards are much smaller.
Watch the full video, it's linked right here.
